ORDINANCE

BEIT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-G in the area bounded by:

A line 50’ north of and parallel to West 69" street; the public alley next east of and
parallel to South Green street; West 69" street; and South Green street;

to those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property:
814 W. 69th Street, Chicago, Illinois 60621
